title: Weighted mixed-norm estimates for fractional parabolic equations with space-time nonlocal operators
summary: We establish weighted mixed-norm estimates for fractional parabolic equations \begin{equation*} \partial_t^αu=Lu-λu+f \text{ in } (0,T)\times\mathbb{R}^d, \end{equation*} with nonlocal operators in both time and space. Here, $\partial_t^α$ is the Caputo derivative of order $α\in(0,1)$, and $L$ is a spatially nonlocal operator of order $σ\in(0,2)$ whose kernel is merely measurable in time. We also obtain the corresponding estimates in the odd mixed-norm spaces, where the inner integration is taken in time and the outer one in space. The estimates are robust in the limit $α\to1$ and $σ\to2$.…
